data.name: Risk & Responsibility
data.detailed_description:
You are the Environmental Health & Safety manager of a chemical facility. Every decision you make carries weight — for your workers, your company, and your career.

Balance compliance scores, capital budgets, risk metrics, and political pressure as you navigate OSHA audits, whistleblower reports, vapor releases, and the quiet friction of a facility that never stops running. When crisis strikes, time slows and the real test begins.

Manage what matters:

  • Monitor your facility through a live risk heatmap. Green zones can turn red without warning.

  • Navigate a 12-month regulatory calendar of OSHA audits, environmental reviews, and board pressure

  • Respond to operational events, media scrutiny, supply chain disruptions, and whistleblower reports

  • Balance four interconnected resources: Capital Budget, Compliance Score, Risk Score, and Political Score

  • Make decisions under pressure with no objectively right answer. Only tradeoffs.

When crisis hits: Time slows. Actions are limited. Stakeholders apply pressure from every direction. Your response determines whether you survive the incident or lose your job.

For players who want: A strategy game grounded in real systems. Corporate drama with authentic stakes. The satisfaction of keeping a complex operation running when everything is trying to make it fail.

Risk & Responsibility was designed by a developer with 15 years of professional experience in Environmental Health & Safety and ESG. The scenarios, regulatory systems, and ethical dilemmas in this game reflect real decisions faced by EHS managers every day.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580, 4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070 / AMD RX 5700, 6GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
